role: Rust port on already viewed data; not held-out validation
algorithm: projective point-to-plane ICP with keyframe depth fusion
raster: round ties to even, nearest positive camera Z, equal Z lowest source index
model_frame: accepted keyframe optical coordinates; first optical camera remains root
primary_clock: strictly new measured depth; no RGB used
loss: latched beyond age, no implicit reset, rejected acquisition never refreshes
atomicity: failed fit leaves pose/reference/model and accepted clock unchanged; valid observed clock may advance
intentional_difference_from_prototype: re-evaluate final correspondence RMS at the returned pose before acceptance
acceptance: retain all updates; report full root accuracy and failures; do not widen gates to match prototype
